targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS time, avg(JSONExtractInt(payload_json, 'latency_ms')) AS render_latency_ms FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type = 'media.render.completed' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT occurred_at, resource_id, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'aspect_ratio') AS aspect_ratio, JSONExtractBool(payload_json, 'technical_passed') AS technical_passed, JSONExtractBool(payload_json, 'multimodal_passed') AS multimodal_passed FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type = 'media.render.completed' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
